_meta.description: Grouped Process summing revenue by region with two overlays, OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_TOTAL (streamable) and OVERLAY_DELTA_VS_SIBLING (buffered): one buffered overlay runs the whole request buffered. The layers can travel with an export, from the library only: run the request, set the pio.ExportJob's Overlays to the response's overlays (IncludeOverlays nil or true) and call (*Pulse).Export with an Arrow target. The Arrow file gains a top-level LIST<STRUCT> field named overlays carrying both layers in its first record batch; the host batches are unchanged. The CLI export leaves carry no overlays. Parquet embeds them the same way, Excel as sheets, NDJSON as a trailer, and CSV / TSV warn and skip them (pio.ExportJob's IncludeOverlays and Overlays docs); kinds and payloads: skills/overlay-system.md.
_meta.name: export-overlays-arrow
